cues.en: Using the fire sticks to make fire

cues.zh: 这种方法会让你起水泡
cues.en: this method can gives you blisters

cues.zh: 用石锥在上面钻一个孔
cues.en: Drilling a hole in it with a stone awl
Pecking a hole with the stone awl
Quartz sand added to help drilling process

cues.zh: 把内层树皮与外层树皮分离
cues.en: separating the inner bark frome outer bark

cues.zh: 把内层树皮劈成更细的条
cues.en: splitting the inner bark into thinner strips

cues.zh: 将各股纤维顺时针捻转，但把它们反向（逆时针）绞合在一起。这样可以防止绳子散开
cues.en: Twist the individual strands clockwise, but twist them together anti clockwise. This prevents the cord from unravelling
carving a notch in the stick

cues.zh: 用一条树皮把绳子系在凹口上
cues.en: Tying the cord onto the notch with a strip of bark

cues.zh: 当绳子向外拉出时，纺锤棍就会旋转。当绳子完全解开时，石头的惯性会把它重新绕回棍上，然后反方向重复这一过程
cues.en: As the strings are pulled out wards, the spindle spins. When the strings are completely unraveled, the stones momentum wraps them back around the stick and the process is repeated in the opposite direction

cues.zh: 从黏土中挑出石块和树枝
cues.en: Picking out rocks and sticks from the clay

cues.zh: 把灰撒在石头上，防止黏土粘连
cues.en: Putting ash on stone to prevent clay from sticking
Tying the ends of the crossbar onto the drill

cues.zh: 现在用泵动的方式拉动绳子向外，而不用手（避免握绳磨出水泡）
cues.en: Now the bar is used in a pumping motion to pull the strings outward instead of using the hands (avoids blisters from holding cords)
